About the security content of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2

This test page lists the fixes in a made-up release. Notes refer to vulnerabilities by CVE-ID where one exists.

macOS Sequoia 15.8.2

Released October 26, 2026

Accelerate

Available for: macOS Sequoia

Impact: An app may crash.

Description: Bounds checking was improved.
